`eruda.js` is the unmodified browser distribution from npm package
`eruda@3.4.3`. Its MIT license is in `../ERUDA-LICENSE`.
The inspector imports this file directly so the checkout and staged
desktop builds use the same input. When upgrading, refresh the file,
license, and the declarations for the APIs used in `mobile.ts`.
